title: ExoMiner: 301 new planets validated in Kepler data
summary: The ExoMiner neural network, run on the Pleiades supercomputer, validated 301 planets from the remaining Kepler candidates, adding to the 4,569 already validated; none is Earth-like or in the habitable zone. “Validated” is statistical, not confirmed; NASA’s 2026 count gives 370 for the same work, an unexplained discrepancy.
organization: NASA Ames Research Center and NASA JPL
